summary: This document describes how to use Suite B cryptography with Secure Shell, using elliptic curve Diffie-Hellman, ECDSA, and AES in Galois/Counter Mode. Suite B was a US government set of algorithms. The RFC has historic status.

eli5.summary: Suite B was a government-approved set of secret-code tools. This explained how to use them with SSH, but it is now historic and kept for the record.

questions: ssh with ecdh and ecdsa suite b
